summary: Describes how Ethernet VPNs can answer ARP and IPv6 Neighbor Discovery requests on behalf of hosts, using the ARP/ND Extended Community. This cuts the flooding that these requests cause in large broadcast domains, such as at Internet Exchange Points and data centers. It updates the EVPN specification with fuller operational documentation.

eli5.summary: Rather than shouting across a big room asking who has a name, a helper who already knows answers for them.

questions: reduce arp flooding in data center
